title: Primitive roots for every admissible integer base

result.label: Primitive roots for every admissible integer base
result.statement: Proves the infinitude assertion in Artin's primitive root conjecture for every integer a that is neither −1 nor a square. For each such base, at least ca x/( x)^2 primes in every sufficiently large interval (x,2x) have primitive root a , with ca 0.
